title.zh: 时序函数生成与完整分布评估
title.en: Temporal function generation and distribution recovery

source_publication.title: FunDiff: diffusion models over function spaces for physics-informed generative modeling

provenance.zh: 构图与评估变量参考 FunDiff 论文 Figure 2；公开 CSV 由 simulate_data.py 使用固定种子 20260427 生成，用来演示样本量增加时参数分布趋近目标范围、重建误差下降的图式。它不是论文原始数据、作者 checkpoint 的输出或对论文数值的数字化提取。
provenance.en: The composition and evaluation variables are inspired by FunDiff Figure 2. The bundled CSVs are generated by simulate_data.py with fixed seed 20260427 to demonstrate parameter-distribution recovery and falling reconstruction error as training size grows. They are not paper data, outputs from author checkpoints, or digitized numerical results.

zh: 每个训练样本量对应的模型标识、随机种子、训练配置，以及每条生成函数的唯一 sample_id。
每条函数的坐标、生成值和按明确模型拟合或重建的函数值；同一 sample_id 必须共用坐标网格。
每条生成函数拟合得到的幅值 A、阻尼 gamma、角频率 omega、竖直位移 b，以及生成曲线与重建曲线之间的 MSE。
目标参数分布或可信参数边界；若真实任务没有解析参数，应替换为有定义的函数特征，而不是保留本例参数。
en: Model ID, seed and training configuration for every training-set size, plus a unique sample_id for each generated function.
Coordinates, generated values and fitted or reconstructed function values for each function on a shared coordinate grid per sample.
Fitted amplitude A, damping gamma, angular frequency omega, vertical shift b and the MSE between generated and reconstructed curves for every sample.

The target parameter distribution or defensible parameter bounds. If the real task has no analytic parameters, replace them with defined function features rather than retaining these example variables.

preprocessing.zh: 真实复用时，对每条生成曲线用预先声明的四参数阻尼正弦模型做拟合，保存 A、gamma、omega、b 和逐曲线 MSE；每个训练样本量选择 MSE 最大的曲线作为上排 worst case。下排小提琴图使用同一批样本的拟合参数与 MSE。演示模拟器不执行生成模型训练或曲线拟合，而是直接产生带有明确假设的代理分布和一致的曲线残差。
preprocessing.en: For real reuse, fit every generated curve with the declared four-parameter damped sinusoid, save A, gamma, omega, b and per-curve MSE, and select the maximum-MSE curve at each training size for the top-row worst case. Bottom-row violins must use fitted parameters and MSEs from those same samples. The demo simulator does not train a generative model or fit curves; it creates explicitly assumed proxy distributions and consistent curve residuals.
